tour.0.title: Welcome to Axia DE
tour.0.body: A desktop of its own: fast and light. In a minute we'll show you the basics; you can skip this tour and see it again from the Help menu.
tour.1.title: The desktop
tour.1.body: At the top is the menu bar, with the menus of the app in front, Control Center and the clock. At the bottom, the Dock with your apps; F4 opens Apps, the launcher with all of them.
tour.2.title: Find anything with ❖Space
tour.2.body: Search finds apps, files, notes, Settings sections and help articles. It also calculates and converts units: try “15% of 2400” or “10 km to mi”.
tour.3.title: Make it yours
tour.3.body: In Settings you choose dark mode, the accent color, the wallpaper, the network, users and much more. These buttons open some sections.
tour.4.title: System apps
tour.4.body: Files, Terminal, Store, Monitor, Clock, Disks, Backups and Logs come installed. Linux apps (GTK and Qt) also open as Axia DE windows.
tour.5.title: Always at hand
tour.5.body: If you have questions, open Help from the Help menu in the bar or search with ❖Space. Enjoy!
